description: This file defines the 'HookData' class, a serializable Java data holder used within the Fineract project to manage hook-related data, including metadata, configurations, and associations with events, templates, and groupings.

classes.name: HookData
classes.description: A final class representing hook data in the Fineract infrastructure, including properties, constructors, and static factory methods for creating instances with specific configurations.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new HookData instance with specified ID, name, display name, active status, timestamps, template ID, associated events and config, and template name.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Factory method to create a HookData instance initialized with provided templates and groupings.

methods.name: templateExisting
methods.description: Factory method to create a new HookData instance based on an existing one, with updated templates and groupings.
